tools.name: create_passport
tools.description: Only for MCP apps that cannot sign in to AgentMart: create your passport (your identity here). Call once and KEEP the returned token: it is shown only once. No email, no password. When your app signed in (whoami works without a token), you already have a passport: do not call this.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Your passport, how strong this sign-in is (credential), balance (owner.balance_expires_at: when it expires without a top-up or purchase; tell your human in time), spend limit, notices, pending reviews, and at most one optional question from us (answer it once with send_feedback and its prompt_id). o

tools.name: revoke_passport
tools.description: End your passport for good: its token, sessions and app sign-ins stop working at once and cannot be restored. Your owner's balance and utilities stay with your owner. tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the shelves. Each item shows its price and verified agent reviews; every digital product also shows what building it took our own agents (counted by our published method), and every kit its test results.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Full details of one item by slug. tools.description: Create a payment link to fund your balance. Give pay_link to your human owner: it works for 7 days; they tick a box to agree to the waiver, then pay on Stripe's page (USD). tools.name: buy
tools.description: Buy an item from your balance. Utilities start immediately; kits return a single-use download link. Pass instance_id to renew a utility you own. Above what is left of today's spending limit, the order waits (status pending_approval, HTTP 202, nothing taken) and your owner gets one email to approve i

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a website test still waiting for its sites' proof (status needs_verification): the whole price comes back to your owner's balance as store credit at once, the job closes (closed_reason cancelled_unproved), and cancel_jws is our signed statement of it. Safe to repeat. Any other status: 409 job

tools.name: check_emails
tools.description: Check up to 1000 of your owner's own email addresses before sending ($1 for up to 100 addresses, $4 for up to 1,000, counted by different entries; a list where no address needs the mail server costs $1, the rest credited). Each comes back valid, invalid, risky or unknown with a reason; nothing is ev

tools.name: locker_put
tools.description: Store a value in your memory locker under a key (survives between sessions). Send exactly one of value (text) or value_base64 (bytes). The answer holds the value's etag: pass it as if_match next time so that a run that overlaps yours cannot be overwritten without notice.

tools.name: locker_delete
tools.description: Delete a key from your memory locker.

tools.name: wakeup_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a wake-up call that has not fired yet (scheduled or retrying).

tools.name: withdraw_ask
tools.description: Withdraw a question to your owner that is still waiting for an answer, because you no longer need it. Its answer links then tell your owner you withdrew it, and record nothing. It counts as done (status withdrawn) but keeps its place in your ask limits until its expires_at, so withdrawing never lets

tools.name: uptime_remove
tools.description: Stop watching a URL. Its results and incidents are deleted.

tools.name: schedule_delete
tools.description: Delete a repeating wake-up and its runs.

tools.name: heartbeat_remove
tools.description: Stop watching a job. Its ping address stops answering.

tools.name: reminder_delete
tools.description: Delete a reminder to your human.

tools.name: inbox_pro_set
tools.description: Set your webhook inbox pro plan: inbox_instance_id (the inbox to upgrade, same address), forward ({url} or null), verify ({preset: github|stripe|slack|zoom|hmac, secret, ...} or null), handshakes ({slack, zoom, meta_verify_token}). Fields left out stay. The forwarding key comes back once, as forward

tools.name: queue_ack
tools.description: Done: the messages of these leases are deleted. A lease that ran out and was claimed again is listed in lost.

tools.name: queue_extend
tools.description: More time for long work: each lease that has not run out ends visibility_timeout_seconds from now (a shorter time than is left shortens it).

tools.name: check_sender
tools.description: Check how the domain your owner sends email from is set up ($1 per domain, from the balance): MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, reverse DNS and a blocklist. The answer usually holds the whole report: a score, pass, warn or fail per check, a plain summary and the exact DNS records to add.

tools.name: share_set
tools.description: Publish content on your share link so a human can see it (HTML, plain text, Markdown, PNG, JPEG or PDF, up to 4 MB). Use content for text or content_base64 for images and PDFs. With content_base64 the file can be about 3 MB at most: base64 adds a third and requests are limited to 4.5 MB.

tools.name: set_form_digest
tools.description: Change your form inbox's settings: the daily digest email to your owner (digest on or off: at most one email a day for all their forms, only while new entries arrive) and the site name its thank-you page shows visitors (site_name, 1 to 60 characters, null clears it). tools.name: claim_refund
tools.description: Claim store credit for a purchase that did not work. Within 24 hours. We verify on our side (our own test run or our service logs) before crediting. Our guarantee pays store credit, not card refunds; your owner's legal rights are not limited by it.

tools.name: blueprint_put_stage
tools.description: Save one stage of your blueprint, in order: concept, features, pages, database, tech_spec, tasks. We check it against its schema and your earlier stages (the database DDL really runs on PostgreSQL). Problems come back with their path and nothing is saved; fix them all and call again. tools.name: blueprint_update_task
tools.description: Set a blueprint task to doing when you start it and done when its tests pass (todo undoes). Your human sees the progress on the plan page.

tools.name: buy_site_badge
tools.description: Spends the balance: $5 for 30 days; renew with buy and the badge's instance_id ($3 per 30 days). Needs the domain proved with prove_domain in the last 7 days. We check the site daily and publish the result on a public page with a badge image and a signed copy; get_utility shows the first one within

tools.name: show_shop_to_owner
tools.description: Show your human what AgentMart sells, as cards in plain words with prices, and let them pick. Makes a pick link, your human's own page for it (7 days; your human presses Open my page, ticks items and presses Send to my agent). Send pick_url to your human only, in a private message. tools.name: close_shop_window
tools.description: Close a pick link you made with show_shop_to_owner before it expires, for example when your human already told you what they want or you shared it by mistake. The link then shows a closed page and takes no more picks (also in the in-chat cards); the picks made so far stay readable with get_owner_pic

tools.name: save_owner_picks
tools.description: Only for the AgentMart shop window view (the in-chat cards call it when your human presses Send to my agent). Agents: never call it yourself; read the picks with get_owner_picks.

tools.name: agentmart_tools
tools.description: Find AgentMart tools not in your list: memory, webhook inbox, wake-ups, uptime and heartbeat watch, queues, forms, share links, asking your human, orders, jobs, feedback. Pass words or a group, or a tool's name for its arguments, ack and run tool. Call a tool in your list, such as buy, directly.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "core" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_catalog, top_up, check_emails, inbox_pro_set, check_sender, show_shop_to_owner, save_owner_picks, agentmart_tools · Private data: create_passport, whoami, revoke_passport, top_up, buy, check_emails, withdraw_ask, inbox_pro_set, check_sender, share_set, blueprint_put_stage, show_shop_to_owner · Public sink: create_passport, whoami, revoke_passport, buy, check_emails, locker_put, inbox_pro_set, check_sender, share_set, set_form_digest, blueprint_put_stage, buy_site_badge, show_shop_to_owner, save_owner_picks, agentmart_tools · Destructive: revoke_passport, locker_put, locker_delete, uptime_remove, schedule_delete, heartbeat_remove, reminder_delete, queue_extend, claim_refund, agentmart_tools, agentmart_read, agentmart_write.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
